ModMetaData.name: Trader ships (continued)
ModMetaData.author: AUTOMATIC1111, IoIqq
ModMetaData.description:
Trader spaceships visit your colony and trade with you like a visiting caravan, no orbital trader or trade beacon required.
Ships prefer to land in your landing zone, and can be sent away when you are done with them.
1.8 adds a standalone Trade desk building, auto-generated themed fleets for every faction (medical, weapon, apparel, food, resources, industrial, furniture, relic, general), talent and slave ships, chartering a specific ship type for silver, compensation demands when you damage a ship, full cargo drops when one is destroyed, and factionless stowaways.
By default a comms console is still required; you can turn that off in mod settings.
This is the 1.7 (Waylith engine) continuation of AUTOMATIC1111's original Trader ships mod, kept up to date by IoIqq. Original design, art and code belong to AUTOMATIC1111.
